messages:
sylvia_partner_ops: FYI Sigma (marketplace SI) reported intermittent 500s from the Dedicated connector since 08:10 UTC. Theyre asking for a shared war-room and an escalation map.
anna_pm: Thanks Sylvia. Is this causing revenue-impacting outages or degraded UX? Need severity.
mohit_sales: Sigma = Tier A partner and marketplace listing is live -> treat as P1 for customer-impacting errors. Looping in their AE @sigma_ae.
sigma_ae: Confirming production impact for ~30% of requests to marketplace route. Customers are opening tickets.
lucas_sre: Oncall here. I'll spin up an incident channel: #partner-sigma-2080011222. Proposed initial flow: SRE triage -> Eng on-call -> Partner-eng -> Partner-ops for comms. PagerDuty tag partner:sigma, severity=P1.
isabel_engineering: Suggest adding fallback route to hosted model variant with traffic-split feature flag. If fail rate >20% for 15m, auto-failover to hosted-r1. Need config change review.
sylvia_partner_ops: I'll create channel and invite partner contacts + s-rep lists. What should be pinned?
mohit_sales: Pin: 1) customer impact statement 2) required SLAs for updates (every 30m) 3) mitigation toggles + runbook link 4) comms owner (mohit) 5) PD incident link. I'll handle partner comms cadence. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Channel created -> #partner-sigma-2080011222. PagerDuty incident PD-4801 created and linked. Auto-notify to SRE oncall and partner-ops.
lucas_sre: Triage goals: ack <10m, gather error samples and recent deploys <30m, mitigation plan <90m. If no progress by 2h escalate to Eng Manager + Product + Sales. OK?
sylvia_partner_ops: Agreed. Also add handback criteria: verification of fix in prod for 60m, canary traffic at 5% for 24h, RCA draft within 72h.
isabel_engineering: I'm collecting logs and request IDs now. Suspect change in connector pool sizing after last deploy. Will paste logs in channel in ~12m.
mohit_sales: I'll check marketplace listing and advise on temporary notice for customers. If sigma wants announcement paused, tell them to hold.
anna_pm: Creating shared status doc and pinning it -> https://drive.redwood/sigma-sev-status (internal). Keep timeline live there.
lucas_sre: Pinned runbook + checklist. Added links to rollback steps and traffic-split playbook. Isabel, can you test rollback to previous connector build and report results?
isabel_engineering: Doing a quick rollback test in staging and a dry-run in prod shadow. Will report within 20m.
sylvia_partner_ops: Scheduling a tabletop tomorrow 09:00 PT to formalize the SEV routing map for marketplace partners and to document shared channel naming conventions. Invite will go out.
mohit_sales: Thanks team. I'll coordinate joint updates with Sigma and log customer replies in the status doc.
lucas_sre: Reminder: keep channel for triage only. Deeper design convos should go to #partnerships-design or threads. We'll close PD after handback checklist complete.
sylvia_partner_ops: Loop closed for now 1; war-room live and owners assigned. I'll draft postmortem outline once RCA is ready.
